title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Business Travel Itinerary Management
summary: This document explains how to use the Business Platinum Rewards Card business travel concierge to submit itineraries, include traveler profiles and preferences, and centralize bookings and confirmations. It also covers itinerary updates/changes using a booking locator, disruption monitoring and alternative routing, and maintaining digital confirmation copies; it states concierge travel desk availability is Yes.
